records.original_sql: SELECT LIST(n) FROM (SELECT n FROM ex.cache_filtered(rows := 10000) ORDER BY n LIMIT 5);
records.replacement_sql: SELECT array_agg(n ORDER BY n) FROM (SELECT n FROM ex.cache_filtered(rows := 10000) ORDER BY n LIMIT 5);
records.reason: DataFusion spells DuckDB's LIST aggregate array_agg; retaining the explicit element order preserves the exact result.
